title: Rosie O’Donnell Ends Late Night Stint With a Ditty to ‘Donny Boy’
summary: “It’s kind of weird to think he spent more nights with me this week than Melania,” O’Donnell said of President Trump on her last night guest-hosting “Jimmy Kimmel Live.”
